description: 5 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-14 under road-to-sentences-the-tree-can-back, which added this skill's Sourcing section — every segment, category and alternative claim now carries a cited source — and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the three entry points the skill's own 'When to use' names: a contested or missing category sentence a downstream artefact is about to inherit, a team that can say what the product does but not who it is for or against what alternative, and a request for the opposable audit the skill's inversion model drives. Near-misses are the three handoffs the skill's own 'Do NOT use' line names: peer-versus-peer feature comparison (competitive-positioning), copy generation (messaging-architecture), and pricing-tier construction, which this skill explicitly hands off. Counterexamples guard the homonym in the skill's own name: CSS positioning and camera position both say position and ask for no market frame.

queries.q: we can't agree what category we're in, and the launch page copy is due Friday — lock the frame first
everyone here can describe what the product does but nobody can say who it's for or what it replaces
run an opposable audit on our positioning claims — which of them could a competitor credibly argue the opposite of?
what should we refuse to be? I want the non-goals written down before anyone writes a tagline
für wen sind wir eigentlich, und gegen welche Alternative — die Kategorie ist bei uns völlig unklar
build me a feature-by-feature comparison table against the two tools we lose deals to
the frame is settled — now write the homepage headline and the three supporting lines
queries.note: copy generation downstream of a locked frame → messaging-architecture

queries.q: how should we cut the tiers — what goes in Pro versus Enterprise?
queries.note: pricing-tier construction, which this skill hands off by name

queries.q: the tooltip is positioning itself off-screen on narrow viewports — fix the absolute positioning
position the camera behind the subject for the next shot and keep the key light where it is
queries.note: says position, means a camera placement
